import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
df = pd.read_csv('medical_records.csv') # patient_id has repeated rows per patient
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(df.drop(columns=['target']), df['target'], test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
test_cases.notes: Repeated patient_id records split randomly, leaking patient identity across train/test
